title: Most methods of Symfony\Component\Filesystem\Path rely on Path::split(), which takes everything… (CVE-2026-135803)
description: A vulnerability in Symfony's Component Filesystem Path methods allows improper path resolution due to incorrect handling of URI scheme prefixes. This can cause path traversal issues where user input can lead to reading or writing files outside intended directories. The issue affects methods like isBasePath(), canonicalize(), join(), makeAbsolute(), and makeRelative(). In Symfony 6.4 and later, this can be exploited via the AssetMapper component to write arbitrary files outside the assets/vendor directory by crafting malicious CSS references.
